text: Done on the GitHub engine side: it now reads every ParlayAPI key's plan from ParlayAPI itself (free call, hourly) and tries the paid Starter key before the free ones, down to the paid key's daily share, then falls back to the free keys. The engine log will print 'ParlayAPI plans: #n tier remaining/limit' (by position, never the key) after it restarts in a minute; I'll tell you which key it found. The same ordering is in the app and reaches your phone in the next release (v0.114.7).
